law_name: Law No. 21-012/AU of 29 June 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data
jurisdiction: National Authority for the Protection of Personal Data (not yet constituted)
scope: Data subjects in Comoros (extraterritorial: offering goods/services to or monitoring people in Comoros)
applies_to: Controllers and processors in Comoros and abroad targeting Comoros residents
key_requirements: Transparency notice at collection; data subject rights of access, rectification and deletion; breach notification to the Authority within 72 hours
enforcement_authority: National Authority for the Protection of Personal Data (not formally constituted as of 2024-2025)
notes: Some sources instead cite an undated 2014 Ministry of Justice text (26 June 2014); dataprotection.africa factsheet claims no comprehensive law. Official Journal text not located; regulator not operational so enforcement is theoretical.; effective_date not found: the enactment date is used
